title: Non-Text Content Alternatives
remark: All meaningful images have descriptive alt text; decorative images use alt=''; AccessibleCaptcha provides audio equivalent.
recommendation: Maintain alt text quality during content updates.

title: Alternatives for Pre-Recorded Media
remark: No pre-recorded standalone audio/video media files exist in the core application.
recommendation: Provide transcripts if podcasts/audio files are added in the future.

title: Captions for Pre-Recorded Media
remark: No pre-recorded video media exists in the application.
recommendation: Add closed captions (.vtt) if instructional videos are uploaded.

title: Audio Description for Pre-Recorded Video
remark: No pre-recorded video files exist.
recommendation: Provide secondary audio track or descriptive transcript for video content.

title: Live Media Captions
remark: No live streaming media broadcasts exist in the application.
recommendation: Ensure real-time captioning support if live webinars are hosted.

title: Audio Description (Extended)
remark: No pre-recorded video content requiring extended descriptions.
recommendation: Ensure rich audio descriptions if multimedia video library is introduced.

title: Information and Structure
remark: Semantic HTML5 tags (<header>, <nav>, <main>, <footer>, <section>, <table>, <th scope='col'>) used across all 42 routes.
recommendation: Continue using native semantic elements over generic div blocks.

title: Meaningful Reading Sequence
remark: DOM order matches visual flow; flex and grid layouts maintain linear document structure.
recommendation: Avoid CSS order manipulation that breaks logical tab sequence.

title: Non-Sensory Instructions
remark: Instructions avoid purely shape, position, or sensory cues (e.g., text labels accompany all directional cues).
recommendation: Avoid using 'click the green button on the right' in copywriting.

title: Orientation Flexibility
remark: Application does not lock screen orientation; renders fluidly in portrait and landscape.
recommendation: Preserve responsive flexbox/grid containers.

title: Input Purpose Identification
remark: Autocomplete attributes (name, email, tel, address-level2, postal-code) implemented across Contact and Partner forms.
recommendation: Maintain autocomplete standards on any new customer onboarding forms.

title: Use of Colour
remark: Color is never used as the sole visual means of conveying information; icons and text labels accompany error states.
recommendation: Ensure charts and data tables include pattern or direct text labels.

title: Audio Control
remark: No audio autoplays; audio captcha only plays upon explicit user button click.
recommendation: Never enable autoplay on audio or video elements.

title: Text Contrast
remark: All body text meets >= 4.5:1 and large text meets >= 3:1 against background colors; high-contrast toggle provides extra enhancement.
recommendation: Audit all future marketing banner colors before release.

title: Text Resize
remark: Layout supports 200% text zoom and includes dedicated toolbar A- / A / A+ font scale adjuster.
recommendation: Avoid fixed pixel heights on text containers.

title: Images of Text
remark: All headings and textual content use live typography; images of text avoided except brand logo.
recommendation: Ensure infographics provide HTML table/text alternatives.

title: Content Reflow
remark: Reflows seamlessly down to 320 CSS px width without horizontal scrolling or clipped content.
recommendation: Keep testing mobile viewports during layout changes.

title: Non-Text Contrast
remark: Form input borders, custom select arrows, and active button outlines meet >= 3:1 contrast against adjacent colors.
recommendation: Maintain #767676 or darker border outlines for neutral inputs.

title: Text Spacing
remark: Styles accommodate line height (1.5x), paragraph spacing (2x), and letter spacing adjustments without truncation.
recommendation: Ensure container overflow styles allow expanded text.

title: Hover and Focus Content
remark: Tooltips and dropdown menus remain hoverable, dismissible with Escape key, and persistent until dismissed.
recommendation: Use standard accessible tooltip components.

title: Keyboard Accessibility
remark: All interactive elements, buttons, menus, dropdowns, forms, and modals are fully operable via Tab, Enter, Space, and Escape.
recommendation: Ensure future widgets include complete keyboard event listeners.

title: No Keyboard Trap
remark: Modal focus trap is safely contained within dialog and allows clean exit via Escape key or close button.
recommendation: Maintain useEffect cleanup for modal keydown listeners.

title: Keyboard Shortcuts
remark: Shortcuts use standard modifier keys (Ctrl+K / Cmd+K for quick search) and do not override browser single-key navigation.
recommendation: Do not assign single printable character keys as global triggers.

title: Timing Adjustable
remark: No arbitrary timeout forces page refresh or form cancellation.
recommendation: Provide session extension warning if authenticated portal is added.

title: Pause, Stop, Hide Moving Content
remark: Accessibility Toolbar provides global 'Pause Motion' toggle stopping CSS animations and marquee movements.
recommendation: Honor 'pause-animations' CSS class on any new animations.

title: Flashing Content Limits
remark: No flashing or strobe content exists in the application (zero elements exceed 3 flashes per second).
recommendation: Prohibit flashing elements in all marketing banners.

title: Bypass Repeated Content
remark: Skip Link (<SkipLink />) is the first interactive element in DOM, jumping directly to <main id='main-content'>.
recommendation: Ensure skip link remains unobstructed across all page templates.

title: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
remark: Focused elements are not obscured by sticky navigation headers; scroll padding (scroll-pt-28) ensures full visibility.
recommendation: Maintain scroll-padding-top in global layout CSS.

title: Descriptive Page and Screen Titles
remark: Every page exports unique, descriptive metadata titles following the pattern: [Page Name] | Ratnakar Securities.
recommendation: Ensure new routes configure specific metadata in layout/page.

title: Logical Keyboard Focus Order
remark: Tab sequence follows logical reading order top-to-bottom and left-to-right.
recommendation: Avoid positive tabindex values.

title: Link Purpose (In Context)
remark: All links have descriptive anchor text or aria-label describing exact destination; external links include screen reader annotations.
recommendation: Avoid generic 'Click Here' or 'Read More' link text.

title: Multiple Ways to Find Pages
remark: Website provides Header navigation, Footer directory, Quick Search (Ctrl+K), and dedicated HTML Site Map at /sitemap.
recommendation: Keep HTML sitemap updated as new routes are published.

title: Descriptive Headings and Labels
remark: Headings describe topic/purpose hierarchically; form labels clearly indicate required information.
recommendation: Maintain one H1 per page followed by proper H2/H3 nesting.

title: Visible Keyboard Focus
remark: High-contrast 2px focus rings (focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#003366]) applied to all interactive controls.
recommendation: Never use outline: none without providing an accessible focus-visible alternative.

title: Single Pointer Operation
remark: All actions operable with single pointer tap/click without requiring multi-point or path-based gestures.
recommendation: Keep custom sliders operable via click/tap and keyboard arrows.

title: Pointer Cancellation
remark: Pointer events execute on mouseup/touchend; dragging away cancels click action.
recommendation: Do not trigger permanent state changes on mousedown.

title: Label in Name
remark: Accessible programmatic name matches visible text label on all buttons and form controls.
recommendation: Ensure aria-label includes the visible text prefix.

title: Motion Actuation
remark: No core features rely on device shaking or tilting; verification required on specific mobile device sensors.
recommendation: Provide UI button fallback if device shake gestures are ever introduced.

title: Dragging Movements
remark: Calculators and forms provide single-click buttons and standard numeric inputs alongside any range controls.
recommendation: Always provide discrete numeric inputs alongside sliders.

title: Target Size (Minimum)
remark: Interactive buttons and links provide minimum 24x24px touch target (>= 44x44px for primary mobile navigation and form buttons).
recommendation: Maintain touch padding on mobile icons.

title: Page Language Identified
remark: Root layout declares <html lang='en'> dynamically determinable by browser and screen readers.
recommendation: Keep lang attribute on root <html> tag.

title: Language of Parts
remark: Non-English statutory terms or regional content are marked with appropriate lang attributes where necessary.
recommendation: Tag Hindi or Gujarati statutory phrases with lang='hi' or lang='gu'.

title: No Change on Focus
remark: Focusing on inputs, links, or buttons never triggers unexpected navigation or form submissions.
recommendation: Do not bind automatic submit or redirection to focus/blur events.

title: No Unexpected Change on Input
remark: Changing dropdown selection or input value does not automatically submit form without explicit user action.
recommendation: Require explicit submit button click for all form operations.

title: Consistent Navigation Order
remark: Header, footer, search, and navigation menus maintain identical relative order across all 42 pages.
recommendation: Maintain centralized layout templates.

title: Consistent Identification of Components
remark: Buttons, search bars, icons, and error labels share consistent visual styling and accessible nomenclature.
recommendation: Use shared UI component library tokens.

title: Consistent Help
remark: Customer Support phone (+91 079 4900 7900), email, and contact links appear in consistent locations in header, footer, and contact pages.
recommendation: Keep support contact info accessible across every template.

title: Input Error Identification
remark: Form validation identifies invalid fields, highlights borders in red, and presents text error messages with role='alert'.
recommendation: Ensure errors are announced programmatically via live regions.

title: Input Labels and Instructions
remark: Every form control includes permanent visible label, explicit required indicator (*), and descriptive format hints.
recommendation: Do not use placeholder text as a substitute for labels.

title: Error Correction Suggestions
remark: Validation messages provide specific corrective guidance (e.g., 'Please enter a 10-digit Indian mobile number starting with 6-9').
recommendation: Provide clear format examples in error feedback.

title: Error Prevention for Legal/Financial Submissions
remark: SEBI Risk Disclosures, Confirmation dialogs, and validation reviews prevent unintended submission of sensitive data.
recommendation: Provide confirmation steps for irreversible account submissions.

title: Redundant Entry
remark: Multi-step processes avoid requiring duplicate entry of identical contact or account information.
recommendation: Auto-populate previously verified fields in workflows.

title: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
remark: Login dialogs support password managers, copy-paste, and accessible audio CAPTCHA without cognitive function barriers.
recommendation: Never block clipboard paste into password fields.

title: Correct Markup Structure
remark: Clean HTML structure with unique IDs, properly nested tags, and zero obsolete markup errors.
recommendation: Run automated linters regularly to maintain valid DOM tree.

title: Accessible Name, Role, and State
remark: Custom selects, dialogs, accordions, and buttons declare correct ARIA roles (dialog, listbox, option), aria-expanded, aria-controls, and aria-modal.
recommendation: Prefer native semantic HTML elements before reaching for ARIA.

title: Programmatically Determinable Status Messages
remark: Dynamic submission results, calculator totals, and search notifications are announced using role='status' / aria-live='polite'.
recommendation: Use aria-live='polite' for non-disruptive announcements.

title: Documents on website in ePUB or OCR
remark: Digital PDF documents hosted on downloads page require OCR verification for scanned statutory notices from external authorities.
recommendation: Convert legacy scanned PDFs to tagged searchable PDFs or HTML pages.

title: Audio description, sign language interpretation, close captioning
remark: No public broadcast video material requiring sign language interpretation exists in the web application.
recommendation: Include sign language interpretation if official regulatory video announcements are hosted.
